old: His heart growled within him: as a mother dog
new: His heart growled within him, and as a mother dog
reason: Butler: “His heart growled within him, and as a bitch with puppies growls” — the edit adds a colon over Butler’s “, and”, and PUNCTUATION §6 allows an added colon only to introduce a list.

old: I’m grown up now; I know good from evil and understand what’s going on,
new: I’m grown up now, I know good from evil, and I understand what’s going on,
reason: Butler: “I am grown up now to the knowledge of good and evil and understand what is going on” has no mark here; the edit adds a semicolon that Butler did not write (D21/D27 count it as an added dividing mark), and a three-part list avoids it.

old: “Someone else would trust an ally weaker than me,
new: “Anyone else would trust an ally weaker than me,
reason: Butler: “any one else would trust a worse ally than myself” — Athena’s claim applies to everyone; the accessibility edit changed v1’s correct “Anyone” to “Someone” without any stated reason, which weakens it to one other person.
